_note: Pixel particle physics and living floor pixels (src/vfx/particles.gd). Particles fly in the floor plane with a height above it. gravity: px/s^2 pulling the height down; bounce: share of the fall speed kept when a particle hits the floor (below bounce_min px/s it stops); wall_bounce: share of the speed kept when it hits a wall cell; ground_friction: extra drag per second while sliding on the floor; settle_speed: below this px/s a resting debris particle becomes a floor pixel for good; spawn_height: default height in px of a burst above the floor point under it. modes: gravity (factor of gravity, negative rises), lift ([min, max] upward px/s at the start), settle (lands and stays as a floor pixel), glow (lights up in the bloom layer, at glow_alpha strength, 0.32 when absent), fade (fades out over its life instead of staying solid). max_particles caps the live particles (the oldest settles or vanishes first). kick: blasts lift floor pixels again; every loose debris pixel in reach flies, a pool or stain pixel only with stain_share; speed px/s at the centre, lift [min, max] px/s, at most max_particles per blast. liquid: splats keep creeping outwards; spread_rate pixels per second per pool, budget_scale x the splat's pixel radius squared = pixels it may still try, reach_scale x radius = how far from its centre, dry_after s after it stops it dries darker by dry_darken; max_pools spread at once (the oldest dries first). ember: glowing floor pixels left by fire, life [min, max] s, smoke_rate puffs per second at full heat, colours hot to cool, soot left behind, at most max. frost: frost pixels melt to water after melt_after [min, max] s, water dries away after evaporate_after s (+-30 %), at most max waiting. smoke_color: colour of smoke puffs. Purely visual. soft_cap: share of max_particles above which the cosmetic emitters throw fewer (none at the limit; particles.gd room). z_ease: 1/s weightless matter (motes) eases to the height it is pulled to. glow: the bloom of a glowing particle is tight round its pixel, radius px + per_size x its size, alpha at most alpha_cap; embers ember_r [cold, hot] px at ember_alpha (review 2026-10-31: glow must not wash out the pixels). comet (the Urknall's Gefuege units, particles.gd comet): trail_max drops follow the lead, each trail_lag of its flight later and trail_gap px short; where a blob strikes it splashes: crown droplets (+1 per unit) thrown on along its flight, cells pool cells per unit (at most cells_max) spread spread x sqrt(cells) art px round the spot; a soul comet puffs pop motes. modes.flake: a snow flake (almost weightless, drag 1/s, it lies as frost that melts: melts).

fire._note: Flames (particles.gd flames, fire_burst): ramp hot to cool (a flame runs down it as it ages), life [min, max] s, size [small, big] crypt px, smoke_chance a dying flame leaves a puff of smoke, burst_per_px / burst_max flames of a fire burst by its radius. Buoyancy and lift: modes.flame. User request 2026-10-30: fire as physics. ember_sparks (the talents' fat fire explosions, user feedback 2026-10-31): glowing sparks (mode glut) at spark_speed [min, max] px/s that bounce and lie down as embers dying over ember_lie [min, max] s, leaving spark_soot of a full soot pixel.

ice._note: Rigid ice (particles.gd shatter, rime_grow): ramp spec, lite, body, shade, deep; a shard on the floor loses slide_decel px/s every second (dry friction: it skids a short way and stops) plus friction (1/s; ground_friction is 9), keeps bounce of its fall and leaves a frost fleck where it strikes the floor, breaks into chips when it hits a wall faster than shatter_speed px/s, scratches a frost pixel every scratch_every px it slides (0: no trail); rime is a frost crust rime_core of its reach wide (thick in the middle, loose crystals at its rim; rime_fill: how full, share of its pixels by how near the middle) with rime_branches times the asked ferns, rime_reach of the reach long, leaning rime_axis towards the floor joints, growing rime_rate art px/s, at most rime_max growths at once. User request 2026-10-30: ice as physics. Snow (particles.gd snow): flakes start flake_height [min, max] px over the floor, pulled flake_pull x their spin towards the middle. A lying shard's tip glints (glint_share of them, at most glint_max at once) one beat in every glint_every of the 12 fps beat for glint_life [min, max] s while its frost lies.
ice._crust_note: frost_crust (a thrown ice potion, review A6): its rim frayed by crust_ragged, it goes after frost.melt_after x crust_melt s, rim first, thinning by the dither (vapor frost, no water sheet).

void._note: The void (particles.gd well, implode): ramp spec, lite, body, shade, deep; an implosion pulls with implode_pull px/s inwards and implode_spin round for implode_time s, then shows a frame of void and throws a pressure ring. Motes are streaks (modes.mote). User request 2026-10-30: void energy as physics.

elements._note: Colours of the remaining elements (particles.gd sparks, rubble, dust_flat, holy, shadow): spark streaks, stone (lit top, body, dark bottom), dust, holy light and gold, shadow (ink, its cold violet rim); shadow_hold s a grown shadow holds still, shadow_back s it takes to draw back into its pool tip first. User request 2026-10-30: all elements as physics.

blow._note: A pressure front (shockwave ring, scream sound) shoving pixels outward as it passes (particles.gd blow): hop [min, max] px/s upward for what lies on the floor, max_lift floor pixels (embers, loose rubble) lifted per call. glut mode: a glowing pixel (a blown ember, a lava drop) that falls and lies down again as an ember; over a sinking liquid (set_sink, the hell's lava) it is gone.

liquid._note: Splats as pixel matter (particles.gd splat, review A6 2026-11-01): the body is a grain of the colour's shades at alpha + core_alpha (its rim at alpha), its outline lobed and its rim frayed by ragged; blobs smaller bodies round it; drops [min, max] pixels or short streaks (single_drops of them one pixel) thrown along the hit, drops_per_px per px of radius. Dried marks fade after fade_after s (+-15 %) over fade_time s, rim first; fade_keep of their pixels stay as specks at residue_alpha of their opacity; at most max_fading marks fade at once (the oldest is done at once).

shot._note: The talents' impacts (particles.gd drops, motes, chips; src/vfx/talent_fx.gd): drops px/s along the hit (poison, blood, water; they land and lie as floor pixels) for drop_life s; motes px/s drifting out (soul, spirit, curse; the void implodes instead) for mote_life s; chips px/s (bone, steel, gold, stone, beast: they fall, bounce and settle) for chip_life s. User request 2026-10-31: every spell as the matter of its element.

fuse._note: The Leerenmagier's Gefüge as matter in the Singularität's well (particles.gd fuse_feed, _step_fusion, _fuse_pair, _blob_matter, _draw_fused; user 2026-11-01: its particles fuse, everything simulated). A blob floats height px over the floor, slowed by drag per s, pulled by pull_scale of its well's pull and swirl (the swirl divided by its units: heavy matter sinks in); the core keeps it: within the core plus its own radius it is drawn to the middle at center per s and its speed falls by hold per s. The smaller blobs of a well are drawn to its heaviest one at cohesion x sqrt(its units) px/s^2; two blobs of one well fuse when closer than reach x their radii summed; a blob of n units is PIXEL x (size + grow x sqrt(n)) px across, at most size_max; it turns at spin rad/s, its rim flashes for flash s when it fuses, it is drawn as up to lumps lumps of its elements (shuffled by its own seed, so they lie mixed all through it), and it throws off a bit of its own matter every bits_every / sqrt(n) s.
